title: Agora theme: This theme provides a front-end design for transparency and open-government sites, including a table preview of CSV files attached to content. (CVE-2026-114533)
description: The Agora theme for Drupal provides a front-end design for transparency and open-government sites, including a feature to preview CSV files attached to content. However, it insufficiently checks file access when rendering these previews, allowing visitors who cannot download the file to still read its contents on the page. Additionally, previews rendered for one visitor can be cached and shown to others. This vulnerability only affects CSV files stored outside the public file system and requires additional access restrictions beyond content access. Files stored in the public file system are not impacted. A patch is available for versions prior to 1.2.3.
aiSummary: The Agora theme for Drupal (versions before 1.2.3) has a vulnerability where it does not properly verify file access permissions when rendering CSV file previews. This allows users who are denied file downloads to still view the contents of those CSV files via the preview feature. Furthermore, the preview content can be cached and served to other users, potentially exposing sensitive data. The vulnerability is mitigated if CSV files are stored in the public file system or if additional access restrictions are implemented. A patch addressing this issue is available.
aiImpact: Unauthorized users may view the contents of CSV files attached to content even if they are denied direct download access. This could lead to unintended disclosure of sensitive or restricted data through the preview feature. Cached previews may also expose data to other users. The impact is limited to files stored outside the public file system and where additional access controls are not in place.
